intro.name: Viktor Nešić

caseStudy.title: Bikini
caseStudy.lead: Android and iOS apps for a bikini competition in Asia: contestants post videos and photos, fans follow, vote and buy extra votes, judges score every stage, and live calls bring the audience close to the contestants.

facts.label: Platform
facts.value: Two native apps: iOS and Android

brief.title: The brief
text: The organisers run their competition by country and in stages. They wanted the whole event in one app: contestants showing themselves through videos and photos, fans following and voting, judges scoring, and a way to earn from votes and subscriptions.
I built two separate native apps, one for iOS and one for Android, on a shared Firebase backend.

contributions.title: What I did
items: Built the iOS app natively with UIKit, RxSwift and SnapKit, organised in feature modules.
Modelled contests by country with stages, start and end dates and a registration deadline.
Kept new contestant accounts under review until an administrator approves them to post videos and photos.
Built the video feed with caching, comments and music, and a camera with effects, stickers and emoji.
Built voting with vote levels, judges' votes per stage and extra votes bought through in-app purchases and Stripe.
Added followers, likes, messages, online users and audio and video calls on Agora, with push notifications and Facebook sign-in.
Built the Android app natively in Java with XML views and a clean architecture.

team.title: Team
team.text: I built both apps myself, working directly with the client.

outcome.title: The result
outcome.text: The whole competition in one app on each platform: registration and approval, stages, votes from fans and judges, paid votes and live contact with the contestants.

architecture.title: Architecture
architecture.text: Two native apps on one Firebase backend, with real-time calls and payments as services.

items.title: Sign up and get approved
items.text: Contestants register before the deadline; an administrator reviews each account before it can post.

items.title: Stage by stage
items.text: Each country's contest runs in stages, and every stage closes with a result.

items.title: Fans and judges
items.text: Fans vote and can buy extra votes; judges score each stage.

items.title: Close to the contestants
items.text: Follow, like, message and call contestants in audio or video.
